**STEP 1 - Scene:** Airline-style breakfast tray: fried eggs, toast, a savory muffin, orange juice, and a butter portion.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** Two white paper plates. Main plate (right) ~20 cm, area ≈ 314 cm². Side plate (left, muffin) ~17 cm, area ≈ 227 cm². Both are part of this meal.

**STEP 3 - Items:** Fried eggs, toast, savory muffin, orange juice (glass), butter portion.

**STEP 4 - Area (main plate, 314 cm²):** Eggs ~25% (78 cm²); toast ~28% (88 cm²). Muffin covers ~13% of the side plate (30 cm²).

**STEP 5 - Volume:**
- Eggs: 78 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 94 ml
- Toast: 88 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 106 ml
- Muffin: 30 cm² × 5 cm ≈ 150 ml
- Juice: ~200 ml in glass
- Butter: ~7 g

**STEP 6 - Grams:**
- Eggs: 94 ml × 0.95 ≈ 89 g
- Toast: 106 ml × 0.3 ≈ 32 g
- Muffin: 150 ml × 0.4 ≈ 60 g
- Juice: 200 ml × 1.02 ≈ 205 g
- Butter: 7 g

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
- Fried eggs: 89 g × 196/100 ≈ 175 kcal
- Toast: 32 g × 265/100 ≈ 85 kcal
- Muffin: 60 g × 250/100 = 150 kcal
- Juice: 205 g × 45/100 ≈ 92 kcal
- Butter: 7 g × 717/100 ≈ 50 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** Total ≈ 390 g and ≈ 550 kcal. That fits a full airline breakfast tray with a large juice serving and two plates of food.
